published_ranges._ams: 1 kg spools sold as AMS compatible
published_ranges._notes: Specific gravity 1.06 and Tg 105C from the 'Atomic Filament - ABS based 3D Filament' SDS (rev 08/03/2021); no ABS TDS published. Drying 80C 4-8h from the Atomic FAQ (ASA/ABS). Maker: less warp than typical ABS. Also sold in 3.5 kg.

conflicts: Gray, Gun Metal Gray and Black 3.5 kg pages and the Gray sample coil give nozzle 235-250C (https://atomicfilament.com/products/3-5kg-black-abs-filament); ~34 other ABS pages give 235-255C (used).
